limitations: The sufficient parameter region is not proved sharp; neither uniqueness nor an exact count of all periodic cylinders is asserted. The publisher full text was not inspected; unindexed equivalent theorems remain an originality risk.
scientific_integrity: The theorem is an analytically proved existence of at least two periodic cylinders; six finite numerical witnesses independently test but do not prove it. All original-time claims follow from an exact polynomial coordinate shear without time reparametrization.
title: Two simultaneous periodic cylinders in a nilpotent-Jacobian polynomial flow
